floor_history.headline: _spu_note2pitch = prefix + inlined COMPLETED-C sibling _spu_2pitch (GNU89 inline, sibling byte-neutral) + fold-const ternary abs -> mips abssi2; honest floor 37 -> 2, residual is one sched1 birthing-p

frontier.hypothesis: The u16->u32 mask writes a multi-set user variable that is the actual for _spu_2pitch's atten and not the call target; a byte-neutral live second set exists (candidates: a value consumed in the prefix before the arms, or a variable the clamp already writes without a copy).
frontier.mechanism: sched.c birthing_insn_p reg_n_sets==1 gate; integrate.c maps a REG_USERVAR_P actual directly onto the parm (no copy) when it does not overlap the target.
frontier.next_probe: Start from memory/grind/_spu_note2pitch/candidate.c (score 2) and rejected/receiver-multiset-tail-move.c (score 6); enumerate second-set spellings, sandbox each, read main.sched block 7 for the andi's priority.

frontier.hypothesis: The birthing test can be defeated without a second set if the andi's destination is not in bb_live_regs at readiness (check how schedule_block updates bb_live_regs).
frontier.mechanism: sched.c schedule_block / sched_note_set liveness bookkeeping around birthing_insn_p.
frontier.next_probe: Read sched.c around lines 2500-2530 and the bb_live_regs updates in schedule_block; run the instrumented cc1 with BB2_SCHED_DEBUG=1 on form F to print ADJPRI for the andi.

frontier.hypothesis: A byte-neutral respelling of the sibling makes ratio's init single-set so the li is also boosted and the LUID tie-break applies.
frontier.mechanism: same sched1 birthing gate applied to the inlinee's pseudo.
frontier.next_probe: Only if frontier 1 dies: try sibling spellings that keep the literal 0x103B shift/add chain and a single running variable, re-verify sandbox _spu_2pitch = 0 for each.
